meta.name: El caballero de los Siete Reinos
meta.description: Ambientada en una época en la que el linaje Targaryen todavía ostenta el Trono de Hierro y el recuerdo del último dragón aún no ha desaparecido de la memoria viva, grandes destinos, enemigos poderosos y hazañas peligrosas esperan a estos improbables e incomparables amigos.

videos.title: El caballero errante
videos.overview: En su camino al torneo de justas en Ashford, Dunk conoce a un astuto niño llamado Egg, quien se ofrece a ser su escudero.

videos.title: Carne Salada
videos.overview: Dunk intenta convencer a varios lores para que le permitan participar en el torneo... pero Egg le aconseja mantener su orgullo. Cuando los Targaryen llegan a Ashford, Dunk aprovecha la oportunidad para hablar con el príncipe Baelor.

videos.title: El Escudero
videos.overview: Luego de que Egg intenta entrenar al indomable caballo de Dunk, este le enseña a su nuevo escudero una habilidad importante. Mientras disfrutan del primer día del torneo, Dunk recibe una propuesta del ayudante de Ashford que podría asegurar su futuro.

videos.title: Siete
videos.overview: Dunk exige un juicio por combate para demostrar su inocencia, pero Aerion tiene un idea más peligrosa.

videos.title: En nombre de la Madre
videos.overview: Cuando un amigo le sugiere escapar de su triste vida, el joven Dunk duda entre su pasado y un nuevo futuro.

videos.title: El Mañana⁩
videos.overview: Mientras Ashford lamenta una gran pérdida, Dunk evalúa su próximo movimiento... y si mantener a Egg como su escudero o no.

videos.title: A Knight In The Making - Episode 1
videos.overview: Follow A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms from the page to the screen in this fascinating and comprehensive look at how HBO's newest series in the Game of Thrones universe was brought to life.

videos.title: A Knight In The Making - Episodes 2 & 3
videos.overview: Get the full scoop on Episodes 2 and 3 of A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms in this behind-the-scenes special that explores character arcs, the eye-popping jousting sequences, and the stunning Ep. 3 climax.

videos.title: Inside the Episode - Episode 1
videos.overview: Peter Claffey (Dunk), Dexter Sol Ansell (Egg), and Daniel Ings (Lyonel Baratheon) go inside the premiere episode of A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms and discuss Dunk's motivation for being a knight, why Egg wants to squire, and what Lyonel sees in Dunk.

videos.title: Inside the Episode - Episode 2
videos.overview: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms' showrunner Ira Parker, Peter Claffey (Dunk), Dexter Sol Ansell (Egg), and Bertie Carvel (Baelor Targaryen) take a deeper look inside the second episode. They discuss Ser Arlan's legacy, the Targaryens' arrival in Ashford, and Dunk meeting Tanselle Too-Tall.

videos.title: Inside the Episode - Episode 3
videos.overview: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms' showrunner Ira Parker, Peter Claffey (Dunk), Dexter Sol Ansell (Egg), and Finn Bennett (Aerion Targaryen) dive deeper into episode 3 of #AKOTSK. They discuss Dunk and Egg's relationship, Aerion Targaryen's shocking joust, and the unexpected revelation after Dunk defends Tanselle against Aerion.

videos.title: Inside the Episode - Episode 4
videos.overview: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms' showrunner Ira Parker, Peter Claffey (Dunk), Dexter Sol Ansell (Egg),  Finn Bennett (Aerion Targaryen),  Edward Ashley (Steffon Fossoway), and Bertie Carvel (Baelor Targaryen) dive deeper into episode 4 of #AKOTSK. They discuss where Dunk and Egg stand after the big reveal, the Trial of Seven, and Ser Steffon Fossoway's shocking betrayal.

videos.title: Inside the Episode - Episode 5
videos.overview: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms' showrunner Ira Parker, Peter Claffey (Dunk), Dexter Sol Ansell (Egg), and Bertie Carvel (Baelor Targaryen) break down Episode 5 of #AKOTSK. They discuss Dunk's past, the Trial of Seven, and Baelor Targaryen's ultimate sacrifice.

videos.title: Inside the Episode - Episode 6
videos.overview: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms' showrunner Ira Parker, Peter Claffey (Dunk), Dexter Sol Ansell (Egg), Daniel Ings (Lyonel Baratheon), Shaun Thomas (Raymun Fossoway), and Sam Spruell (Maekar Targaryen) explore the events and themes of the #AKOTSK season finale. They discuss the aftermath of the Trial of Seven and what's next for Dunk and Egg as the unlikely duo ventures off through Westeros.

videos.title: A Knight In The Making - Episodes 4, 5 & 6
videos.overview: Watch an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the making of A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms Episodes 4-6 from showrunner Ira Parker, Peter Claffey (Dunk), Dexter Sol Ansell (Egg) as well as the crew. Learn about the details that went into capturing the pinnacle Trial of Seven scenes and the logistics of how everything came together to bring the tale of Dunk and Egg from page to screen.
